<!--
  An onboarding checklist: the tasks with a done mark, a progress bar or a count. Axes: layout (card, plain),
  progress (bar, text, none), marker (check, number), tone (default, muted).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Task } from "./checklist.types";

export type ChecklistProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  tasks: Task[];
  progressLabel: string;
  layout?: "card" | "plain";
  progress?: "bar" | "text" | "none";
  marker?: "check" | "number";
  detail?: "always" | "expand";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Disclosure from "../primitives/disclosure/disclosure.vue";
import IconBadge from "../primitives/iconbadge/icon-badge.vue";
import List from "../primitives/list/list.vue";
import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Progress from "../primitives/form/progress.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Summary from "../primitives/disclosure/summary.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  tasks,
  progressLabel,
  layout = "card",
  progress = "bar",
  marker = "check",
  detail = "always",
  tone = "default",
} = defineProps<ChecklistProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" measure="2xl">
    <Stack
      gap="4"
      align="stretch"
      :class="(((layout as string) === 'card') ? 'rounded bg-card p-6 inset-ring inset-ring-border' : '')"
      data-testid="checklist"
    >
      <Progress v-if="((progress as string) === 'bar')"
        :value="
          Math.round(((tasks.filter((i) => i['done']).length * 100) / (tasks?.length ?? 0))) == null ? undefined
          : String(Math.round(((tasks.filter((i) => i['done']).length * 100) / (tasks?.length ?? 0))))
        "
        max="100"
        :aria-label="tpl(progressLabel, tasks.filter((i) => i['done']).length, (tasks?.length ?? 0))"
      />
      <Text
        v-if="((progress as string) === 'text')"
        size="sm"
        class="text-muted-foreground"
        data-testid="progress-text"
      >
        {{ tpl(progressLabel, tasks.filter((i) => i["done"]).length, (tasks?.length ?? 0)) }}
      </Text>
      <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-4 p-0" data-testid="items">
        <ListItem v-for="(task, i) in tasks" :key="task.id"
          class="flex items-start gap-4"
          data-testid="item"
          :data-done="(task.done == null ? undefined : String(task.done))"
        >
          <IconBadge v-if="((marker as string) === 'number')" :variant="(task.done ? 'primary' : 'outline')" size="xs">
            {{ ((i + 1) == null ? undefined : String((i + 1))) }}
          </IconBadge>
          <LucideIcon v-else
            :name="(task.done ? 'circle-check' : 'circle')"
            :size="24"
            :class="(task.done ? 'shrink-0 text-primary' : 'shrink-0 text-muted-foreground')"
          />
          <Disclosure v-if="((detail as string) === 'expand')" variant="ghost" class="flex-1" data-testid="task-detail">
            <Summary variant="ghost">
              {{ task.title }}
            </Summary>
            <Text size="sm" class="pb-2 text-muted-foreground">
              {{ task.text }}
            </Text>
          </Disclosure>
          <Stack v-else gap="0">
            <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
              {{ task.title }}
            </Text>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ task.text }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </ListItem>
      </List>
    </Stack>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
